The '''lowlands''' were an area on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]] noted for frequent sandstorms, [[Volcano/Legends|volcanoes]] and [[Groundquake/Legends|earthquakes]]. The air in the lowlands was unbreathable by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] due to the toxic contaminants and volcanic ash, but the native [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]] had no trouble. Much of the life in the lowlands was microscopic, but some small [[Insect/Legends|insects]] and [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] survived in the conditions.

There were many [[Mining/Legends|mines]] located in the lowlands, usually operated by Qieg miners living in settlements around the mine. Sealed buildings allowed Humans to live and work in the mines, but the populations of the mining settlements were largely Qieg.

The Qieg maintained shrines devoted to their [[Qieg religion|religion]] in the lowlands, tended by [[Monk/Legends|monks]]. When Qieg were about to become adults, they had to trek to one of the shrines alone as part of the passage rite.
